accepted.evidence: Buddruss prints Gilgit Shina tom tree and compares Burushaski. Turner 13682 stambha includes Wg. štɔ̈̄ma and Kt. štom stem/tree; the independently imported Schmidt Shina database assigns exact tom tree from Gilgit, Kohistani, Guresi and Astori to 13682. This is an inherited stem hypothesis supported by several Shina dialects, while the Burushaski comparison and possible contact influence remain noted.
